key_points: GE Aerospace posted record Q3 results and raised full-year 2026 profit guidance
Stock fell 3-4% post-earnings on margin pressure and premium valuation concerns
CEO publicly reaffirmed 'solid' demand environment for commercial engines and services
GE Vernova (separate public company) dropped 10% on AI financing fears, creating headline noise
Analyst views split: some see buying opportunity, others flag fully-valued cash flow multiple
